# PcanWork

Canonical website: https://www.hexbyte.cn/
Current version: 0.6.0 (released 2026-09-08)
Product type: Windows 10/11 64-bit desktop CAN/CAN FD engineering analysis software.
Technology: Rust + Slint.

PcanWork supports PCAN (PEAK), ZLG, ZHCX and GCAN adapters. Real CAN/CAN FD acquisition and transmission require compatible hardware and the vendor driver. The current release does not provide a virtual CAN bus.

Core capabilities:
- CAN/CAN FD trace, filtering, grouping, statistics, curves, single/periodic transmission, CSV/ASC/BLF recording and replay.
- DBC decoding: Unsigned, Signed, IEEE Float and IEEE Double; Intel/Motorola byte order; factor, offset, unit and range.
- Project files and visual simulation panels with DBC-bound controls.
- printf-over-CAN embedded text logs, plus UDS and XCP entry points.
- Modbus TCP/RTU master and slave tools.
- Serial debugging and ANSI interactive terminal.

Version 0.6.0 changes and verification:
- Offline replay processes large files in batches for fast, normal-speed and step modes, reducing event-queue pressure.
- Curve refresh locates the visible range directly in ring buffers and applies extrema-preserving sampling without copying hundreds of thousands of points every 100 ms.
- The replay window is created on demand and no longer initializes fourteen unrelated feature windows on first open.
- Replay data, progress, loop-boundary connections, absolute date/time axes, panning, box zoom, cursor alignment and independent/shared/normalized Y axes were corrected.
- The curve toolbar uses unified professional icons with 33 x 30 px buttons, 24 x 24 px graphics and a 38 px toolbar.
- CAN, Modbus and Serial themes, responsive layouts, default sizes, centered dialogs and help text were aligned.
- Core, CAN and Modbus backends were split into modules; high-load incremental tables and software stress tests were added.
- Automated tests: 67 passed, 0 failed and 1 network-dependent test skipped.
